name: Yellow
description:
If a tank needs to be camouflaged against the background of vegetation, then it is better to use this paint. The standard green paint is more of a tribute to tradition and copes with this task worse.
See also: Paints
interestingFacts: The paint was added to the game on June 2, 2023.
This paint was only used by helpers in the Party event for {GAME}'s Birthday in 2023. Killing one of these helpers wearing this paint earned the player ultra containers.
Later, the paint could be obtained upon reaching a certain level in the “Summer eSports Tank Fund”, where in order to participate it was necessary to purchase a special offer.
Before update #752 the paint was called «Mono Yellow», after which its name changed and it began to be sold for crystals.

If a tank needs to be camouflaged against the background of vegetation, then it is better to use this paint. The standard green paint is more of a tribute to tradition and copes with this task worse.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
The paint was added to the game on June 2, 2023.
This paint was only used by helpers in the Party event for {GAME}'s Birthday in 2023. Killing one of these helpers wearing this paint earned the player ultra containers.
Later, the paint could be obtained upon reaching a certain level in the “Summer eSports Tank Fund”, where in order to participate it was necessary to purchase a special offer.
Before update #752 the paint was called «Mono Yellow», after which its name changed and it began to be sold for crystals.
